how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:hunter-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8151:details:0: Ogtinc of ⟦E1⟧ has sent out a call for seasoned hunters such as yourself. He is a furbolg hunter who has left his tribe to aid the Cenarion Circle. His teachings are meant to enrich the wisdom of others who share his craft, and guide them toward maintaining a balance. You would do well to speak with him.
rows.quest:8151:details:1: BOgtinc resides atop the cliffs of ⟦E1⟧, northeast from the Ruins of Eldarath.
rows.quest:8151:completion:0: It is no longer my purpose to hunt, but to teach the ⟦1⟧. That is what fate has handed to me.
rows.quest:8151:completion:1: BCraft with me a ⟦2⟧'s charm -- a collection of trophies from fallen prey that will remind you of your past trials and triumphs. In the end I will keep the charm, but reward you with something else.
rows.quest:8153:obj:0: Bring a pair of Perfect Courser Antlers to Ogtinc in ⟦E1⟧. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast of the Ruins of Eldarath.
rows.quest:8153:details:0: The courser wears the mightiest antlers in the known lands. Such antlers are used to defend the courser, goring an attacker and often damaging the points. Perfect, natural antlers are the sign of an animal spirit with supreme confidence.
rows.quest:8153:details:1: BTo hold such antlers will bestow the same confidence in you.
rows.quest:8153:details:2: BHunt the mosshoof courser, find the perfect antlers and bring them to me.
rows.quest:8153:completion:0: You must possess keen sight and great patience to have obtained these. Well done.
rows.quest:8231:obj:0: Bring 6 Wavethrasher Scales to Ogtinc in ⟦E1⟧. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
rows.quest:8231:details:0: The wavethrasher is an amphibious beast living only here in ⟦E1⟧. They are powerful and resilient.
rows.quest:8231:details:1: BThe tough, reflective scales from a wavethrasher mirror the strength of the hunter.
rows.quest:8231:details:2: BTrack and hunt wavethrashers along the coast of ⟦E1⟧, and bring me their scales.
rows.quest:8231:completion:0: The wavethrashers are not easily defeated, even more so in their watery environment.
rows.quest:8231:completion:1: BYou have proven yourself ready to hunt even deadlier prey.
rows.quest:8232:obj:0: Bring the Tooth of Morphaz to Ogtinc in ⟦E1⟧. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
rows.quest:8232:details:0: Now I set you on a dangerous hunt to slay the green drake, Morphaz, and bring his tooth to me. Morphaz dwells deep in Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the entrance to which lies in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8232:details:1: BIf you wish to defeat him, you must not go alone. This drake is an enemy of many -- seek others who wish to destroy him.
rows.quest:8232:details:2: BThe drake's tooth represents the power a hunter will find in the company of others. Bring it to me and you will have learned much.
rows.quest:8232:completion:0: You have learned the old ways, ⟦3⟧, and for that I offer you a gift from my days as a hunter.
